content: Write-ACL enforcement happens at PlotStore mutator entry (editIntent, setStatus, attach, detach, create) and inside PlotHandle.append() — every code path that produces a PlotEvent calls assertCanEmit(actor, type) BEFORE acquiring the JSON file lock so even no-op calls (e.g. agent attempting editIntent({})) reject. Allowed kinds per event live in EVENT_ACL in src/acl.ts; redirect hints steer agents toward question_posed and users toward note/attach. SPEC §6 is the source of truth.
